# API Contract, Ownership & Sync Checklist: Categories

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the requirements behind the B5 API surface frozen for the C5 client: ownership and authorization, sync and concurrency, the platform set, and the Category Reference.
**Created**: 2026-10-02
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [categories.yaml](../../../docs/openapi/paths/categories.yaml)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements. Depth: standard; audience: PR reviewer. The owner delegated the review to the agent running the design phases, which evaluated each item and fixed the spec where an item failed (resolution log below).
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are all response members of the Category, Platform Category and Category Reference records enumerated with type and nullability? [Completeness, Spec §5]
- [x] CHK002 Does every operation list every error code it can return, including the verification gate, the in-use refusal and the `405` on read-only paths? [Completeness, Spec §5]
- [x] CHK003 Is each item of C5's "Needs from the backend" (use = reference or copy, archiving a platform category, the `system_key` list, the reference shape) answered explicitly? [Completeness, Spec Clarifications, §3, §5]
- [x] CHK004 Is the full `system_key` list frozen with kind, both names, icon key and colour for each entry? [Completeness, Spec §3]
- [x] CHK005 Is the write-body shape for PUT, PATCH, archive and DELETE specified, including what a missing `version` and a version-only PATCH return? [Completeness, Spec §5]
- [x] CHK006 Is the set of server-owned members refused as `UNKNOWN_FIELD` enumerated? [Completeness, Spec §5]
- [x] CHK007 Is "in use" defined, including whether tombstoned referencing records count? [Completeness, Spec FR-008]
- [x] CHK008 Are requirements defined for what happens to references when a category is renamed, archived, deleted, or replayed identically? [Completeness, Spec FR-007, FR-023]
- [x] CHK009 Is it specified whether a reference write moves the wallet's `version`, its `change_seq`, or both? [Completeness, Spec FR-023]
- [x] CHK010 Is the reseeding behaviour for added, changed, removed and re-added platform keys specified? [Completeness, Spec FR-019, FR-020; research R-4]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK011 Is "using" a platform category defined unambiguously (reference, never copy)? [Clarity, Spec FR-017]
- [x] CHK012 Is the name rule stated with exact bounds, trimming, storage of the trimmed value, and duplicate policy? [Clarity, Spec FR-003]
- [x] CHK013 Is the list sort defined precisely (fields, default, byte order, tie-break)? [Clarity, Spec FR-010]
- [x] CHK014 Is the client's lookup order for a transaction's `category_id` stated? [Clarity, Spec §5]
- [x] CHK015 Is the lock order stated as a rule later features must follow, not only as an implementation note? [Clarity, Spec FR-023; ADR-0014 rule 10]
- [x] CHK016 Is SC-001 measurable (a count of categories available, languages covered)? [Measurability, Spec SC-001]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK017 Do the write semantics (version in body, DELETE with body, replay, tombstone conflicts, precedence) match spec 010 so the client reuses its plumbing? [Consistency, Spec §6; spec 010 §5–6]
- [x] CHK018 Is the user-scoped model consistent with the glossary, ADR-0012, ADR-0014 and spec 010 §6 ("no category rights per wallet")? [Consistency, Spec reconcile table, §6]
- [x] CHK019 Is kind immutability stated for both owners, consistent with ADR-0014 rule 8? [Consistency, Spec FR-002]
- [x] CHK020 Is the read-only reference's `405` consistent with the API conventions' Read-only resources section? [Consistency, Spec FR-024]
- [x] CHK021 Are the error codes in spec §5, the contract summary and the path file the same set? [Consistency, Spec §5; contracts/categories-api.md]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK022 Are foreign identifiers (another person's category, a platform category, another kind of record) covered for every write? [Coverage, Spec US2·7, §6 precedence]
- [x] CHK023 Is the race between deleting a category and its first use addressed? [Edge Case, Spec Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK024 Is the concurrent rename vs. transaction write (deadlock) addressed? [Edge Case, Spec Edge Cases, FR-023]
- [x] CHK025 Are former members of a deleted wallet covered for the reference read? [Coverage, Spec FR-024]
- [x] CHK026 Is a retired platform category's behaviour on existing records and in pickers specified? [Edge Case, Spec Edge Cases, FR-019]
- [x] CHK027 Is the fate of a leaving member's references at least recorded as an open question with an owner? [Coverage, Spec §9.6]
- [x] CHK028 Is the archived-category-on-new-transaction question assigned to B6 with a recommendation? [Coverage, Spec §9.3]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK029 Is the verification-gate scope for category writes stated, with the baseline change it requires? [Security, Spec FR-011, Clarifications]
- [x] CHK030 Is non-disclosure of another person's categories stated, including inside a shared wallet? [Security, Spec FR-012, SC-004]
- [x] CHK031 Are logging rules for category names stated? [Observability, Spec FR-011]
- [x] CHK032 Is sizing quantified (categories per person, pages)? [Performance, Spec SC-007]
- [x] CHK033 Is localisation of platform names specified for offline language switching? [Localisation, Spec FR-018, US1·2]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK034 Are the obligations on B6, B7, B8 and B14 (publish, withdraw, usage participants, feeds, lock order) documented? [Dependency, Spec FR-008, FR-022, FR-023; research R-14]
- [x] CHK035 Is the decision record required by the owner (glossary and ADR-0012 change) identified, and is its form (extend, not supersede) justified? [Dependency, Spec FR-027; ADR-0014]
- [x] CHK036 Is the timing of the new catalogue code (frozen now, catalogued with the runtime enum) recorded so the client is not surprised? [Assumption, contracts/categories-api.md; plan A-18]

### Resolution log

| Item | Finding | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| CHK008 | Archive and identical replay were silent about references | FR-023: archiving and identical writes change no reference |
| CHK009 | Undefined | FR-023: a reference write moves the wallet's `change_seq`, never its `version` |
| CHK012 | Storage of the trimmed value unstated | FR-003: stored trimmed |
| CHK007 | "tombstoned-but-restorable" ambiguous | FR-008: live or tombstoned, with the reason |
| CHK016 | "a sensible category" not measurable | SC-001: all 26 platform categories, both languages |
| CHK019 | Platform kind immutability implicit | FR-002: both owners; the seeder refuses a kind change |
| CHK023 | Undefined | Edge case: delete and first use serialise on the category; never both |
| CHK025 | "anyone else" ambiguous for former members | FR-024: including former members of a deleted wallet |
| CHK027 | Missing | Edge case and §9 open question 6 (B9) |
| FR-022 (from CHK008) | Re-publish after withdrawal could duplicate | FR-022: revives the same reference |
